description: This file defines the CreditBureauConfiguration class, which models configuration settings for credit bureaus within the Fineract system. It includes fields for configuration key, value, description, and a relation to an OrganisationCreditBureau. It provides methods for creating instances from JSON commands and updating existing configurations.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing credit bureau configuration settings, with fields for configuration key, value, description, and associated organisation credit bureau. Includes methods for instantiation from JSON and updating fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CreditBureauConfiguration instance from a JsonCommand and an OrganisationCreditBureau.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the configuration fields based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes.
